summary: Portage County, WI: 85-foot Conservation Department tower complete by May 1932 in the Town of Grant; dismantled in October 1967; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Dismantled in 1967 per Stevens Point Journal; statewide list marks it Gone

staffing.status: unused for the last five years before dismantling

events.note: Listed as already completed in district 11 in a Post-Crescent item dated May 13, 1932; the 1967 article says it went up about 35 years earlier
Division of Conservation dismantling the tower in the Town of Grant; article dated October 6, 1967

notes_for_editor: Build and removal facts come from two newspaper items as quoted on the centraluslookouts page; the Post-Crescent item is second-hand and undated beyond May 13, 1932. Brief had no height; 85 feet (25.9 m) added from the 1967 article. Brief agency 'Conservation Department' refined to the District 11 header. Two WebSearch calls returned only the Sand Island Light lighthouse in Bayfield County, which is unrelated and not used. No source describes the site today, so the story says so.
